clips.title: The story
paras: Across Redridge, Theocritus watches Morganth hunt an ancient relic.

From the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest, Theocritus watches the crags of Redridge through his scrying spells. He sees Morganth, a warlock in the Tower of Ilgalar, searching for the Scythe of Elune. Fearing Morganth is close to claiming it, Theocritus asks Alliance champions to stop him before Stormwind is threatened.

The Tower of Ilgalar rises above the Redridge basin, where gnolls and twisted arcane energies fill its halls. Morganth waits at the summit, wielding shadow magic and guarding his research. To reach him, you climb through hostile ground and face the warlock directly. His Pendant of Shadow can be brought back as proof that the tower has fallen and the threat is broken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.
He searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it! If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.
I am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now. So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.
Defeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow. Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hurry, friend, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. In defeating the warlock Morganth, Stormwind is saved from a grave peril.
I offer you this reward most humbly. And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.
But instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
